prompt:
A realistic 9:16 lifestyle photograph in a bookstore. A fictional adult Japanese woman, appearing to be in her late 20s. Position the woman in the center, with the face at 48% width and the visual center (hair, shoulders, upper body) at 48% width. The face occupies the top 17%, shoulders and chest from top to center, connecting to the torso and a pale beige skirt at the bottom. The woman's right arm stretches diagonally toward a bookshelf in the top right, a composition where the arm continuing out of frame is read naturally as an intentional action. Head, face, shoulders, main outfit, and tote bag should not be cut unnaturally; arm base and elbow direction must be accurate.

The woman stands sideways right in front of the shelf, body facing right. Neck slightly extended looking up at the top shelf, showing a profile. Gaze concentrated on the top right shelf, mouth closed, with a calm expression showing curiosity and small discovery. Oval face shape, natural nose bridge and chin, light natural makeup, healthy skin tone. Dark brown hair tied loosely at a low position, leaving fine wisps in front of the ears and temples. Bangs swept lightly to the side, avoiding artificial uniform strands.

Outfit is a plain white sleeveless blouse. Small collar, placket, soft thin cotton with natural wrinkles at shoulders, chest, and waist, with slight translucency but without emphasizing skin exposure. High-waisted pale beige skirt. A cream canvas tote bag hangs from the left shoulder, with a wide strap following the shoulder to the back. Bag body hangs at the hip, plain with no logo. Slight natural body hair visible under the extended right armpit as a realistic life detail, but not as the subject. Left arm down near the body.

Location is a quiet independent bookstore. In the foreground right, a tall dark brown wooden bookshelf with spine colors mainly beige, navy, gray, dark red, and dull green. Text on spines is not legible, appearing as abstract short lines or plain colors. Woman in the mid-ground. Background left shows another shelf, low display stand, and a dark hallway softly blurred to create depth. No prominent ceiling or floor fixtures to maintain a quiet reading space.

Camera at a mid-close distance slightly above chest height, capturing the profile from the left. Focal length around 50mm. Natural perspective on face, shoulders, and arm without wide-angle distortion. Medium depth of field with eyes, profile, white blouse, and nearby shelf in focus. Only the background shelf and hallway are gently blurred. Vertical lines of the frame parallel to the shelves, without distorted or merging shelf tiers.

Primary light from top-left window or large diffuse lighting. Soft neutral light on left cheek, nose bridge, white blouse, and arm, leaving soft shadows on the shelf side. Weak warm ambient light from the ceiling to turn the background slightly amber. Mid-key exposure without blowing out white highlights or losing grain in dark wood. Unified tone of white, cream, beige, dark wood, and dull book colors. Natural pores, fine hair, small catchlights in eyes, detailed hair flow, fabric weave and wrinkles on the blouse, coarse texture on the canvas bag, and subtle grain on the shelves.

High-quality commercial photography, intellectual and natural holiday moment, light consistent with a realistic human body. No text, logos, brands, signatures, or watermarks. Avoid legible titles, extra people, extra arms/fingers, missing hands, merged arms, broken shoulders, wrong finger counts, unnatural armpits, melted books, tilted shelves, repetitive spines, asymmetrical eyes, doll-like skin, excessive skin retouching, over-HDR, or illustrative styles.
